text: Cova is an AI interior design app — you photograph your real room, take a style quiz, and it generates a photorealistic redesign of that exact space while preserving your architecture. The style quiz builds a personal taste fingerprint using a Bayesian model, which then drives a stack of custom-trained LoRAs to make the render actually match your aesthetic. On top of the redesign, every item in the render links out to a real shoppable product, so the whole thing feeds an affiliate commerce layer.
